basic_info.description: Rare high floor, move-in ready 1BD/1BA Symphony Towers condominium with mesmerizing unobstructed downtown views. This bright and airy unit has been thoughtfully updated with a modern floorplan, breakfast bar and an open living and dining space ideal for entertaining. Handsome hardwood floors throughout, in-unit washer/dryer and a spacious bathroom. Bedroom features views along with a walk-in  closet featuring custom shelving. Kitchen highlights stainless steel appliances with a gas range, dishwasher, built-in microwave and  refrigerator. Building offers secure entry and elevator, common rooftop deck, courtyard and bike storage. Independent 1-car garage  parking completes this home. Conveniently located in the vibrant Performing Arts District and a stone's throw to the city's best restaurants, cafes, shops, markets, museums, nightlife with easy access to transportation and so much more.
